# 4 Key Trends Shaping The Future of Canada’s Businesses

The past five years have been marked by several crises and hardships that have led to many changes for entrepreneurs.

Most companies have taken concrete steps to adapt. For example, 52% invested in new websites, 40% developed new online payment methods and 35% incorporated more efficient working methods.

However, economic changes are likely to continue. The study highlights four emerging trends for the coming years.

The good news is that you can take actions to adapt to these trends. For each of them, the study offers strategies to help you prepare to face change.

## Discover in this study

- The four trends shaping the future of Canadian businesses.
- Strategies to help you adapt to change.
- Case studies of entrepreneurs who have found solutions to thrive in today’s landscape.
